ruleSummaries.bottlesumo: Time trial seeding with bottles, then single-elimination head-to-head on an open rectangular table.
ruleSummaries.buildathon: Two-round hackathon: online prelims, then a 2-hour on-site build and pitch for the top 10.
ruleSummaries.lineFollowingBot: Qualification time trial seeding, then best-of-1 head-to-head showdowns on mirrored tracks.
ruleSummaries.roboExhibition: Inter-school project exhibition: display & safety check, then timed judging presentation and Q&A.
